title: Permutation Difference between Two Strings
summary: Given two strings s and t , where each character in s appears exactly once and t is a permutation of s , calculate the permutation difference.
statement: Given two strings s and t , where each character in s appears exactly once and t is a permutation of s , calculate the permutation difference. This difference is defined as the sum of the absolute values of the differences between the indices of the occurrence of each character in s and the indices of the same characters in t . Return this permutation difference.
constraints: s and t are permutations of the same distinct lowercase characters.
For each character, take the absolute difference between its index in s and its index in t.
Return the sum of those differences.
hints: Map every t character to its index for constant-time lookup.
Enumerate s and find the same character’s mapped position.
Distinct characters guarantee one mapped position each, and the sum directly follows the definition.
editorial: Distinct characters guarantee one mapped position each, and the sum directly follows the definition.
